about.title: Cotati Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Cotati is a small town, but its stretch of Highway 116, along with Old Redwood Highway and E Cotati Avenue, still sees a steady flow of collisions each year — 23 injury crashes and 26 people hurt in the most recent full year on record. Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. tend to bring more reported crashes, likely tied to commuter traffic funneling through this compact grid of roads. Whether you were rear-ended near a Highway 116 intersection or sideswiped on E Cotati Avenue, the moments after a crash matter. Insurance adjusters move fast, and what you say — or don't say — early on can affect your claim later. LawProactive doesn't practice law; we simply connect injured Cotati residents with an independent personal injury attorney who can review the facts, deal with the insurance company, and help protect your right to recover for medical bills, lost income, and pain that a collision leaves behind.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before You Talk to the Insurer

items.title: California's Clock Is Ticking
items.desc: You generally have two years from a Cotati crash to file suit, but that window can shrink to as little as six months if a government vehicle or road defect was involved. An attorney can identify which deadline applies before it quietly passes.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Cut Your Recovery
items.desc: California lets you recover damages even if you're partly at fault, but your share of blame reduces your payout. How fault gets assigned on a road like Highway 116 or Old Redwood Highway can make a real difference in what you're offered.

items.title: No Cap Means Your Pain Counts
items.desc: California doesn't limit non-economic damages like pain and suffering in most car accident cases. An attorney working on contingency — no fee unless you recover — can push to make sure that part of your claim isn't shortchanged.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's best to hold off. Insurers often use recorded statements to find inconsistencies or get you to downplay your injuries, and you're not required to give one right away. An independent attorney can talk to the insurer on your behalf so nothing you say is used against you.

items.question: What if my crash happened near a Cotati intersection with no clear traffic signal?
items.answer: Fault in these situations often comes down to witness accounts, photos, and sometimes traffic camera or dashcam footage, especially along busier corridors like E Cotati Avenue or Highway 116. Preserving evidence quickly — before it disappears or memories fade — is one of the most useful things you can do. An attorney can help gather and organize that evidence.

items.question: How long do I actually have to bring a claim after a car accident in Cotati?
items.answer: In most California car accident cases you have two years from the date of the crash to file a lawsuit, but if a government entity was involved — say, a poorly maintained road or a public vehicle — that deadline can be as short as six months. Missing it can end your claim entirely, so it's worth getting a read on your timeline early rather than waiting.
